title: Québec City self-guided walking tour & scavenger hunt
includes: Scavenger Hunt on your smartphone (mobile site, not an App)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for things to do in Quebec City? Choose from 2 different walking tours and 3 start locations. 
Buy either a single or a group ticket.
The Upper Town scavenger hunt takes you from the Plains of Abraham, passing by the Citadel, the Parliament, the Opera, as well as the Capital Observatory.
The Lower Town scavenger hunt starts at Château Champlain or the Cruise Terminal; both follow the same circuit, see the same sites, and end near their start points.
You will need to solve challenges at each stop to discover your next destination.
